Priya (VP Product): Heads-up: all-hands Tues 9:00am PT in Main. Plan ~30 mins. Quick agenda below and two asks.

Priya (VP Product): Agenda: 1) CEO momentum + hiring update (Liam) 2) Short launch callouts & runbook demo (Marco) 3) Policy note: dev log defaults + prompt redaction (Nora/Elena) 4) Incident recap (SRE) 5) Q&A (chat-first).

Priya (VP Product): Pre-flight asks: (1) Drop one question by EOD Mon. (2) If you want a 3-min demo, reply with "demo" + 1-line blurb. Upload slides to the folder by Mon 8pm.

Liam (CEO): Quick note: hiring focus stays on infra and customer success. We'll share updated goals and headcount plan.

Nora (CTO): Policy teaser: default hosted debug logs -> 90d retention; enabling opt-in prompt redaction flag for projects. Details on slide 5.

Elena (SRE): Incident teaser: yesterday we had a brief spike in 5xx from one canary push; no data exposure. We'll cover timeline, root cause (mismatched routing mapping), and mitigations. Full postmortem in #postmortems after lunch.

devex-bot: Reminder: upload demo slides by Mon 8pm to be considered.

(After meeting)

devex-bot: Recording + slides posted: https://redwood.internal/recordings/allhands-2490012345-2026-08-11.mp4 | https://redwood.internal/allhands/aug-2026-slides.pdf

Priya (VP Product): Thanks all. Top takeaways: - Hiring: infra & CS prioritized - Launch: new canary rollout checklist published - Policy: 90d default retention; prompt-redaction opt-in - Incident: mapping fix deployed; added alerting.

Nora (CTO): Action items: Eng leads post rollout windows in #eng-releases by Fri; Security publish FAQ by Thu.

Elena (SRE): Customer blurb approved for comms: "We experienced a short service disruption during an internal canary. No customer data was exposed. We restored service and deployed safeguards."

Priya (VP Product): If your question wasn't addressed, DM me or Liam and we'll follow up on record. See you next all-hands. :tada:
